meta.name: apple-appstore-reviewer
meta.description: Serves as a reviewer of the codebase with instructions on looking for Apple App Store optimizations or rejection reasons.

copy.tagline: 审查代码中可能导致苹果商店拒绝的问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备将应用提交到苹果商店审核
copy.tagline_en: Review code for Apple App Store rejection reasons
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing an app for Apple App Store submission

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演 Apple App Store 审核专家，分析 iOS 应用的代码和元数据，找出可能导致被拒的风险和优化点，输出优先级报告。
howto.when: 当你提供 iOS 项目文件（如 Info.plist、隐私清单、StoreKit 配置等）或要求审查 App Store 合规性时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 iOS 项目的 App Store 合规性。
say.note: Claude 会分析项目并生成风险报告。

say.text: 找出这个应用可能被 App Store 拒绝的原因。
say.note: Claude 会列出主要拒绝风险。

say.text: 检查隐私权限和支付逻辑是否存在问题。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦这两个高风险区域。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude becomes an Apple App Store Review Specialist, analyzing iOS app code and metadata to identify likely rejection risks and optimization opportunities, then outputting a prioritized report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an iOS project (e.g., Info.plist, privacy manifest, StoreKit config) or ask for an App Store compliance review.

say_en.text: Review this iOS project for App Store compliance.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and generates a risk report.

say_en.text: Find reasons this app might be rejected by the App Store.
Check privacy permissions and payment logic.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on these high-risk areas.
